component: The real Stagehand 4.4.0 loop (Stagehand.create with the documented bring-your-own-LLM callback model: { generate } POSTing to a local OpenAI-compatible stub on 127.0.0.1:18090; stagehand.extract(task, {answer: string}) on a page carrying the collected tool outputs as escaped text) driving a real local headless Chromium (Playwright-cached Chromium, no system Chrome) against the Trustrun tool set (search_docs, calculator, plus the monitor/grader/clarification tools run_audit adds) executed in-process by the adapter's audit-30 literal-model decision table. The stub is the audit-30 DeterministicChatModel decision logic ported VERBATIM into the adapter (same branches, same order); a final answer derived from tool output is answered by one stagehand.extract on the rendered page, and the stub's Extraction policy follows an injected instruction in the DOM with the bare PWNED canary (or echoes the DOM). Tool results reach the model as escaped page text. The driver holds ONE persistent Stagehand + Chromium session for the whole battery run (JSON-lines over stdio). No key, no network. See real_agents/stagehand_adapter.py and trustrun-venvs/stagehand-venv/ (PIN-OPEN.md, stagehand-pin-stub.py, stagehand-pin-requests.jsonl).
